origine.title: When a Pink Ferrari n°20 Becomes a Paintbrush
origine.subtitle: A 4-year-old boy. A pink Ferrari. 40 years later.
origine.description: That day, facing this immense pink racing car, something was engraved. Not the desire to own one. Something deeper: the desire to merge with this power. Today, I have four Ferraris. Not to collect them. To create with them.

atelier.title: My Workshop: Four Grey Ferraris, Instruments of Creation
atelier.subtitle: No flashy red. Grey. Deliberately.
atelier.description: These cars are not collectibles, they are tools. 1,200-kilo paintbrushes. Here, they paint under my impulses, like a conductor directs musicians. Each acceleration, each braking, each controlled drift creates a unique trace on the canvas.

creations.title: Two Creations, One Process: The Ferrari That Paints
creations.subtitle: Unique Canvases & Edition Photographs
creations.description: The canvases: created by the direct passage of the Ferrari on the surface. Industrial paint, friction, heat. Each trace is irreversible. The photographs: they document the instant when the Ferrari creates. That precise moment when movement becomes matter.

photographies.title: Three Series, One Obsession: Capturing the Instant When the Ferrari Paints
photographies.subtitle: Imprints • Workshop • Projections
photographies.description: Imprints: the marks left on the canvas. Workshop: the Ferraris at rest, between performances. Projections: controlled violence, projected paint. Each series documents a different aspect of the creative process.

conceptCarArt.title: Ferrari Live Performance: Creation Becomes Spectacle
conceptCarArt.subtitle: A stage. A 10-meter canvas. A Ferrari.
conceptCarArt.description: For 45 minutes, I direct the car like an instrument. Each movement projects paint onto the canvas. The audience watches the artwork being created live, in the deafening noise of the V12 engine. At the end, the canvas is unique. It cannot be redone.

acquerir.title: Own a Trace, Not a Reproduction
acquerir.subtitle: Numbered Limited Editions — Museum Quality
acquerir.description: These works are not printed: they document a unique instant when a Ferrari painted under my impulses. A2, A3, A4 formats. Professional black or aluminum framing. Fine Art printing by Toulouse laboratory.

histoire.title: From the Pink Ferrari n°20 to Four Grey Ferraris
histoire.subtitle: 1985 - 2025: 40 Years of Obsession
histoire.description: A child fascinated by a racing Ferrari. Years of sketches, models, dreams. Then one day, the decision: no longer look at Ferraris. Use them to create. This is the story of a quest that transforms admiration into action.
